name: Akito
source: The komainu guardian of the shrine — hardworking, hunky, and fiercely protective of those he cares about. Akito’s sweet nature makes him a fast friend and someone you can rely on, but you soon learn that his dedication to protecting others stems from a tragedy in his past.
